purpose: Plan v1.4 conditional WC-D residual predictability and specialization exploration; DESIGN_ONLY
source_handling: Conversation used as research input; first response novelty optimism superseded by second response corrections. Primary sources checked at listed depth. Proposed mathematics, thresholds, datasets and budgets are local designs, not reported experiment results.

sources.title: DisCa
sources.verification: Primary full text section 3.3 checked: cache/current input/time/condition predictor. No local port or resource availability acceptance.

sources.title: LESA
sources.verification: Primary full text section 3 checked: stage-specific experts; GT-guided and closed-loop autoregressive training. No local reproduction.

sources.title: OnlineCache
sources.verification: Primary abstract checked: policy gradient, learnable corrector and bilevel optimization. Full algorithm and Cosmos port not audited.

sources.title: LinCa
sources.verification: Primary abstract and official README checked: invertible decomposition with component-specific prediction orders. FLOPs reductions distinguished from wall latency; no local port.

sources.title: SVD-Cache
sources.verification: Primary abstract checked: smooth principal and volatile low-energy orthogonal subspaces. Orthogonal feature residual differs from cache prediction error.

sources.title: WorldCache
sources.verification: Primary abstract and local pinned Cosmos cache source checked. Whole deep-skip insertion, post-warp output and same-state shadow interfaces are design targets, not new method validation.

sources.title: POD-DEIM
sources.verification: Primary publication retrieved; reduced representation and cheap evaluation are separate. Not implementing exact residual sampling or claiming free partial dense computation.

sources.title: DAgger
sources.verification: Primary abstract checked: sequential prediction distribution shift. Used as an on-policy labeling analogy, not transferred theorem guarantee.

proposed_cards.question: Causal post-warp same-state label and existing asset audit
Observer OFF/ON smoke then FIT8/CAL4 label collection
Train-only subspace versus cheap coefficient predictability
Single corrector at fixed full schedule; final quality and drift
Whole-call oracle versus learned gate; stage and capacity controls
Quality-time points with fewer full evaluations and conditional independent confirmation
One on-policy label aggregation or supported length/age shift diagnostic

scope: Design docs, source record, overview/current-state/next-actions/handoff/maintained plans only. No runtime, frozen run protocol, weights, labels or budget mutation.
